title: Senior Software Engineer

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Who we are

At Chainguard, we are on a mission to secure the software supply chain by default. Our team is founded by the industry's leading experts on open source software, security, and cloud native development.

Chainguard's product portfolio includes Chainguard Images and Chainguard Services. Customers range from Fortune 500 companies in banking, fintech, government, and infrastructure to startups and SMBs. Join us as we help organizations secure their software supply chain from source to production.

Chainguard delivers the industry's most secure container images: minimal, zero-CVE, rebuilt daily from source. As we scale the number of ecosystems and images we support, this team builds and maintains the systems that keep packages and images current, tested, and building cleanly with as little manual intervention as possible.

• Collaborate across a distributed team: Work closely with teammates across time zones (primarily US/Canada, with close collaboration across EU and India-based colleagues on adjacent squads).

What we're looking for

• 5-7 years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and building complex systems

• Strong Go expertise

• Experience with AI/LLM integration: building systems that use language models for code generation, automation, or developer tooling. Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation, and guardrails

• Systems architecture skills: ability to design loosely-coupled, scalable systems and make pragmatic trade-offs

• Container ecosystem expertise: Docker, OCI, container registries, Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills: ability to write clear technical documents, work autonomously, and collaborate across teams and time zones

description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Black Lotus Labs has an opening for a Senior Lead Threat Analyst that will leverage Lumen’s unique visibility to hunt, investigate, and scale discovery of evolving malicious threats, provide mission-relevant intelligence, and support mitigations on large networks. Our global visibility into one of the world’s largest and most interconnected IP backbones, combined with our computing cluster and analytic platforms, presents exciting opportunities to integrate machine learning, graph analytics, automation, and approved AI-enabled tools as we find new ways to hunt for threats across the internet. Black Lotus Labs has detected and disrupted key evolving threats at an internet scale for years.

This position will work alongside Black Lotus Labs advanced security researchers, data engineers, malware reverse engineers, data scientists, and our customers to tackle evolving threats accelerated by technologies like our Hadoop ecosystem (HBase, HDFS, Spark, Kafka, AirFlow), Elasticsearch and Redis clusters, Docker using Docker Swarm, malware environment, a network of honeypots, and modern AI-assisted research and development capabilities.
This is a close-knit, experienced, amazingly smart team that you can be a part of and help build out.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance w/ CI Poly.

Location

This is a remote position with office visits in Herndon, VA approximately 2 times per month.

• Research latest threat attacker tools, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) with a goal of automating detection.

• Work with cyber operators, when requested, to conduct in-depth investigations on cyber threat activity and provide mitigation guidance.

• Automate investigations through Python scripting and data analysis using visualization in Jupyter Notebooks and Grafana

• Build and maintain trust relationships with other intelligence teams, law enforcement, and other outside groups.

• Support customer RFIs on incidents and emerging threats.

• Use approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, coding, data exploration, documentation, and knowledge discovery while validating outputs through independent analytical judgment.

• Develop repeatable workflows that combine analyst expertise, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities to improve investigative efficiency and analytical quality.

What We Look For in a Candidate

• Candidates must effectively communicate complex domain-specific concepts, ensuring clarity for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with adversary capabilities, infrastructure, and techniques that can be applied in collaboration with supporting teams and partners to discover, track, and defend against the adversaries aggression towards customer networks.

• Experience using OSINT methods for investigation, including discovering novel threats in malware repositories.

• Scripting experience with Python and familiarity with distributed computing.

• Extensive experience hunting threat actors and developing algorithms and techniques to identify new threats from large data sets.

• Deep knowledge of network-based threats and identifying behaviors without attack payloads.

When you join Renaissance ®, you join a global leader in pre-K-12 education technology! Renaissance ’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters-creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

UX Researcher II Job Description

Under general supervision, conduct research efforts and develop clear stories from insights that support partner and team alignment on user-focused goals. This includes collaborating with UX designers, product owners, product managers, and engineers to discover opportunities for future products and validate designs for product optimization.

In this role as a UX Researcher II, you will be responsible for:

• Design, plan, and execute end-to-end research studies using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methodologies with guidance from senior team members

• Conduct and synthesize research projects including user interviews, usability testing sessions, surveys, card sorting, and contribute to A/B testing initiatives

• Synthesize research findings into clear, actionable insights and present recommendations to cross-functional teams with a compelling, influential story.

• Analyze insights from research sessions to identify key opportunities and user needs

• Works collaboratively and communicates effectively with peers and managers

• Monitor and analyze user behavior metrics and usability benchmarks with support from senior researchers

• Support the evaluation and optimization of research methodologies to improve quality and efficiency of insights

• Assist with research operations including participant recruitment, scheduling, and research repository maintenance

Qualifications

• Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, Social Science, Design Research, Psychology, Cognitive Science or related field

• 3-5 years of experience in UX Research or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Proficiency in qualitative research methods including interviews, contextual inquiry and observational studies

• Working knowledge of quantitative research methods including survey design and basic statistical analysis

• Familiarity with mixed-methods research approaches

• Experience with evaluative research including usability testing and heuristic evaluation

• Exposure to generative and exploratory research techniques

• Ability to execute research protocols and discussion guides

• Experience with participant recruitment and screening

• Understanding of research ethics and informed consent practices

• Experience conducting research with diverse user groups

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The SandboxAQ Design team is one unified organization spanning brand, creative, and product, with designers embedded day-to-day in the Business Units they support. This role will initially be working on our AI agentic platform and products.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our central Design team, reporting to the VP of Design. You will define how people build, evaluate, and trust AI agents in an emerging category, making complex technical concepts understandable across both open-source developer products and enterprise control systems. What makes this work genuinely hard: the category is entirely new yet fast-evolving and crowded, and the audiences are deeply varied.

In this role, you will:

- Turn unique value propositions into well-crafted, intuitive UX.

- Design for deeply varied audiences, from command-line-first developers to enterprise security leaders, constantly balancing power, privacy, control, and speed.

- Create coherent experiences across the product's surfaces: command line, web and console, collaboration spaces, onboarding, and documentation.

- Establish the reusable patterns, design principles, and systems thinking the product family grows into.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Drive product vision and direction. Partner with Product and Engineering to define what should be built and how it should work, frame ambiguous problems into clear opportunities, hypotheses, and design directions, break long and complex projects into executable units of work, and identify risks and opportunities to solve collectively.

- Design and prototype in code to accelerate product decisions, customer conversations, and team alignment, collaborating with engineers early so technical constraints shape the design.

- Own visual and interaction design across every surface - command line, web and console, collaboration spaces, onboarding, and documentation - developing and evolving a style guide and design system, and contributing reusable patterns and design principles as the product family grows.

- Ground decisions in evidence. Conduct workshops, qualitative interviews, usability testing, and other research methods, analyze product analytics to improve user interactions, and distil complex, dense information into clarifying data visualizations and views for the various lenses of user archetypes.

- Operate as part of the org-wide design function. Maintain dotted-line, cross-departmental collaboration with design functions in other SandboxAQ Business Units, interface with go-to-market partners on interfaces that support Sandbox's strategic partnership efforts, and travel occasionally to work with teams and customers in person.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

title: Parcel Point Agent
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position

Vinted Go has opened its very own parcel centres in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Paris and Bordeaux, and the network is expanding. At the centre, Vinted parcels can be collected and dropped-off by customers.
As a parcel centre agent in our new parcel point in Amsterdam, you help customers with their parcels, receive and return parcel bags to drivers, and proactively communicate with colleagues to further improve the centre. 

In this position, you’ll

• Assist customers with dropping off and picking up their parcels.

• Facilitate drivers in the drop-off and pick-up of bags.

• Provide guidance and support to customers experiencing issues with their shipments.

• Maintain a tidy and organized work environment.

Requirements

• Previous experience in healthcare administration

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

• Comfortable communicating with parents, caregivers, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.

• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

title: Director, Growth & Retention - Shopper
description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

Shopper is ShopMy's newest business and our biggest bet: bringing the platform that powers creator commerce directly to the millions of people who shop through it. As our first dedicated Shopper growth leader, you will own how ShopMy acquires, activates, and retains shoppers-turning a product that is still finding its footing into a habit for millions of users. This is a full-funnel role: getting people to download and use the app, and then turning them into weekly active purchasers who keep coming back.

Reporting to our VP of Marketing and working closely with our founders and product team, you will set the shopper growth strategy, own the shopper growth and retention budget, lead our initial team on day one, and earn the right to scale it as you prove out the business.

Roles and responsibilities…

• Growth Strategy: Own the full-funnel strategy for Shopper-from awareness and app installs through activation, purchase, and repeat-and set the north-star metrics we manage the business against (weekly active users, weekly active purchasers, etc).

• Acquisition: Build efficient, scalable user acquisition across paid, organic, referral, and partnership channels, with a clear point of view on channel mix, payback, and what to scale versus kill.

• Retention & Lifecycle: Design the lifecycle system that moves users through the funnel and brings them back-onboarding, push, email, in-app messaging, win-back-and grow it beyond promotions and discounting.

• Measurement & Attribution: Establish app measurement and attribution foundations (MMP, event tracking, cohort and funnel analysis) so we know what is actually working and can make resourcing calls with confidence.

• Content & Narrative Distribution: Partner with our editorial team to translate the product narrative into growth. Own how organic storytelling reaches the right shopper segments, and build the operational infrastructure that lets our best organic content flow into paid channels quickly and repeatably.

• Product Partnership: Work hand in hand with product and our founders on the shopper roadmap. Retention for an app is a product problem as much as a marketing one; you will bring the user perspective and growth data into what gets built.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of two (growth and lifecycle) from day one, owning the opportunity to hire and expand the team as the business grows.

• Cross-Functional Storytelling: Translate performance into clear narratives for leadership, and keep founders, product, and marketing aligned on where shopper is headed and why.

Your qualifications…

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description:
Position Overview:
The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. This role requires strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans that deliver measurable results.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Corporate Strategy Development

• Lead the development of short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational goals.

• Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.

• Conduct strategic reviews and adjust plans based on market dynamics.

2. Business Planning & Execution

• Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.

• Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.

• Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

• Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

• Provide insights on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

• Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.

• Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.

• Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

• Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.

• Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.

• Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.

• Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.

• Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

• Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

• Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.

• Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.

• Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.

• Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate planning, or senior leadership roles.

• Proven track record in developing and executing successful business strategies.

• Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and business operations.

Key Skills and Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to drive change and organizational transformation.

Performance Metrics:

• Achievement of strategic goals and business growth targets.

• Success of strategic initiatives and transformation programs.

• Market expansion and competitive positioning.

• Efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.

• Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction.

Success looks like psychiatric standards, reduced unwarranted variation, improved quality and safety, and measurable improvement in psychiatric outcomes. Architect and deliver

title: GRC Manager
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) Manager to build, support, and continuously enhance Baseten’s security governance, compliance, and privacy programs. As one of the early members of our security organization, you will play a key role in ensuring our platform meets and exceeds the highest standards for privacy, trust, and regulatory compliance.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Legal to define compliance requirements, assess platform capabilities, and drive implementation from initial scoping through validation. You will also lead customer assurance efforts, helping customers understand our security architecture and compliance posture while bringing their requirements back into product planning.

Alongside this product focus, you’ll contribute to Baseten’s broader GRC program, including governance, risk management, audits, vendor assessments, and security awareness.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Product Compliance: Translate regulatory, framework, and customer requirements into clear product requirements and technical controls, partnering with Engineering and Product to build compliance into platform design and development.

- Governance & Policy Development: Design, implement, and maintain security governance frameworks, policies, and procedures that align with Baseten’s risk posture and industry best practices.

- Risk Management: Build and manage the company-wide risk assessment program, identifying, tracking, and mitigating key security and compliance risks.

- Compliance Operations: Support efforts to achieve and maintain compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001/27701, HIPAA, FedRAMP and other applicable standards and regulations.

- Audit & Certification Management: Coordinate external audits and certification processes, ensuring evidence collection, control validation, and remediation plans are executed efficiently.

- Third-Party Risk Management: Oversee vendor security assessments and ensure third-party providers meet Baseten’s security and compliance standards.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to embed compliance and risk management into day-to-day operations and technical processes.

- Customer Trust & Assurance: Support customer security questionnaires, due diligence efforts, and documentation requests from prospective and existing clients.

- Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver security and compliance training to ensure company-wide understanding of key policies and responsibilities.

- Continuous Improvement: Stay current on evolving regulatory requirements and lead initiatives to mature our compliance and risk management programs.

REQUIREMENTS

- BS Degree in CS, CE, MIS or equivalent field

- 5+ years of experience in GRC, Security Compliance, or Information Security roles, ideally in a SaaS or cloud-native environment.

- Strong understanding of security frameworks and standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR.

- Proven track record managing compliance audits and certification programs end-to-end.

- Experience working directly with leaders and executives within Enterprise organizations

- Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders to implement compliance and security controls.

- Proven experience driving product compliance

title: Partnerships Strategy & Operations
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Strategy & Operations team to play a key role in building the operational backbone behind our partner ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence. You'll own the systems, automations, data, and dashboards that help our Partnerships team source, co-sell, and scale revenue through resellers, referral partners, technology partners, and strategic alliances.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member is a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function. In this role, you'll be the strategic and operational counterpart to Partnerships leadership. You'll also work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance, Data, and Product to make partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue visible, measurable, and repeatable.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Partner Lifecycle & Process Management: Design, build, and maintain end-to-end processes for the partner journey, including onboarding, deal registration, lead and referral routing, co-sell workflows, and payout or commission handling. Make these processes consistent, automated, and easy to adopt.

- Strategic Partnership to Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor to Partnerships leadership, providing performance reporting, capacity and territory planning input

description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer serves as a business-facing reporting, analytics, and project delivery partner responsible for leading moderately complex to complex business analysis, reporting, and data-driven initiatives. This role partners with business leaders, stakeholders, technical teams, and end-users to understand business needs, define requirements, coordinate project activities, manage deliverables, and support successful implementation of reporting and business intelligence solutions.

The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer applies business analysis, project management, data interpretation, and reporting expertise to evaluate business processes, identify improvement opportunities, translate business objectives into actionable reporting requirements, and deliver solutions that support operational performance, leadership decision-making, and improved consumer experiences.

Work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of business needs, stakeholder priorities, project timelines, reporting requirements, data outputs, and operational impacts requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer acts as a liaison between business stakeholders, leadership, technical teams, and end-users to support the planning, execution, and delivery of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives. This role facilitates requirement-gathering discussions, documents business and functional requirements, develops report specifications, defines project scope, tracks deliverables, manages timelines, and communicates project status, risks, issues, and dependencies to stakeholders.
This role integrates business knowledge and data expertise to ensure reporting solutions align with operational goals and stakeholder expectations. Responsibilities include analyzing business processes, workflows, data needs, reporting outputs, and system capabilities to identify gaps, recommend improvements, and support scalable, repeatable reporting solutions.
The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer may coordinate cross-functional project activities, support project planning, maintain action item logs, document decisions, facilitate stakeholder meetings, assist with user acceptance testing, validate report outputs, and support implementation readiness and change management activities.
In support of reporting and analytics needs, this role works with data from multiple sources to define required data elements, validate data quality, reconcile outputs, create or maintain dashboards, support recurring reports, and ensure reporting solutions provide accurate, meaningful, and actionable information for business users.
The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer begins to influence department strategy by identifying opportunities to improve reporting processes, strengthen governance, increase automation, enhance stakeholder engagement, and improve the delivery of business intelligence solutions.
